verificationScope: The full original arXiv v2 article is retained, with original theorem numbering, all nine figures and fifteen panels, the numerical simulation table, appendix proofs and bibliography. The source files are byte-for-byte pinned. Spearman rho and Chatterjee xi have independently encoded integral definitions and checked bridges; the estimator trace arithmetic and strict-upper-matrix formula are linked to their actual definitions. Theorem 4.2 has a typed statement certificate. The printed estimator average/range, the finite trace-correction inequality and the permutation-sum proof are checked proof documents. Matrix traces and finite sums use explicit ordinary Lean operations; a general independently parsed matrix/summation language remains future work. Other result markers expose compiled counterparts, with precise assumptions and scopes visible. Example 4.6 and simulation data remain original unverified numerical exposition. The sampling theorem requires iid samples and continuous marginal CDFs; the runtime statement uses a specified unit-cost work model. Historical claims, plotted data, floating-point experiments and every remaining literal proof step are not yet certified.
